verdict.rationale: Amplitude has a documented official MCP server that brings behavioral data into AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) and lets users ask plain-language growth questions and get answers without SQL, plus REST/Dashboard APIs for programmatic data access. However, evidence is vendor-marketing only, with no independent/hands-on confirmation of query accuracy or agent workflow reliability, and no detail on what specific query types or data depth the MCP server supports. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of MCP server query accuracy, detailed API/MCP query capability documentation, evidence of complex ad-hoc analytical queries (not just canned Q&A) being answered correctly.
